# Autonomek (ES / EN)

> B2B AI Engineering, Process Automation & High-Performance Web Development firm serving enterprises in the United States, Spain, Mexico, and Colombia. We transform high-friction communication channels (WhatsApp, Web, CRM, ERP) into autonomous client acquisition and operational systems.
>
> Firma de ingeniería de software B2B, automatización de procesos comerciales y agentes de Inteligencia Artificial para empresas en España, México, Colombia y Estados Unidos.

## English Routes & Core Capabilities (`/en`)
- [English Home](https://www.autonomek.com/en): B2B AI Engineering, Process Automation & Sub-Second Web Development.
- [All Services (EN)](https://www.autonomek.com/en/services): Overview of our 4 core engineering pillars.
- [24/7 AI Sales & Support Agents](https://www.autonomek.com/en/services/ai-agents): Multimodal RAG-powered conversational agents on WhatsApp Cloud API & Web that qualify leads, process voice notes/receipts, book calendar meetings, and sync with HubSpot/Salesforce.
- [High-Performance B2B Websites & Technical SEO](https://www.autonomek.com/en/services/high-performance-websites): Next.js platforms engineered for <0.8s load times, Core Web Vitals 95+, Google SEO, and AI Answer Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO).
- [B2B Process & Workflow Automation](https://www.autonomek.com/en/services/process-automation): Mission-critical n8n, webhook, and REST API pipelines connecting CRM, ERP, Stripe, and databases with zero human error.
- [Custom Enterprise Software](https://www.autonomek.com/en/services/custom-software): Proprietary cloud platforms, custom CRMs, multi-tenant SaaS, and real-time BI dashboards.
- [Case Studies & Portfolio (EN)](https://www.autonomek.com/en/projects): 15+ production systems with verified ROI metrics.
